name: study-tutor
description: An Obsidian tutor and quizzer for your notes, using Claude Code or Codex CLI.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/vendor-pyodide.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node esbuild.config.mjs test && node --test tests/out/unit.test.cjs tests/out/learning.test.cjs tests/out/tutoring.test.cjs tests/out/graph.test.cjs tests/out/router.test.cjs tests/out/maths.test.cjs tests/out/ui.test.cjs tests/out/visuals.test.cjs tests/out/presentation.test.cjs tests/out/compiler.test.cjs
